added: Password-based accounts can link Gmail for later recovery through Google sign-in.
Mobile control placement now supports movable buttons and a fixed joystick.
changed: Weekly and monthly boards were reset to use Judgment-era runs consistently.
fixed: Co-op selection freezes, invisible post-Rift enemies and time-zone-sensitive friend presence received fixes.

added: Minute 30 now triggers the invulnerable Arceus Judgment encounter, with an additional escalating legendary every five seconds.
changed: New Rift openings stop from minute 28. The former minute-60 overtime system was removed.
Historical leaderboards were reset for the new endgame rules.
fixed: Gacha unlocks and rewards now save to the cloud immediately.

added: The game gained an in-menu news view and automatic updates that wait for an active run to finish.
changed: Rift opening chances rise after consecutive failed checks. A minute-60 overtime rule was introduced here, then superseded by the October 13 update.

added: Rift victory Bonds allow learned attacks to share an active slot and attack together.
changed: Players can build groups of up to four linked moves, freeing slots as attacks are joined.

added: Physical and special attack categories, separate attacking and defending stats, and the Nasty Plot buff.
Controller support, optional Manual aim, a pause-screen run summary and the Save button.
changed: Swords Dance and Dragon Dance now boost physical attacks only. New-move sampling favors the partner’s stronger side.
Judgment speed has a soft cap and later contact damage increases. Leaderboards restarted for these rules.
Large partners use adjusted player scale and collision sizes. At most three healers, shielders or summoners can be alive in each role.
fixed: Card choices briefly ignore input when they appear, reducing accidental selections.
Leaderboard values are sanitized and validation was tightened.

added: 38 new moves expand the catalogue to 103 moves and 97 evolution recipes, adding homing shots, bouncing attacks, charging beams, spins, shockwaves, vortexes, pushback and stun zones.
Starting move costs 400 coins once per partner and then allows free selection of a legal non-buff opening, including the default.
changed: Single-type partners gain 20% damage with moves matching their own type.
Learning a new move keeps the current active slot; switch when you want to use it.
The game now runs only on pokesurvivor.com; this fan guide opens the official site in a new tab.
Cloud uploads are scheduled after about 30 minutes with pending changes. Use Save and confirm the status before changing devices.
Gacha pulls, run completion and tab switches no longer trigger immediate cloud uploads; browser-local records remain separate.
Co-op can negotiate compact binary messages while retaining compatibility with older JSON peers. This reduces traffic; it does not guarantee a connection on every network.
Relay-server deployment support was added to the project. Its presence in the repository does not confirm that a relay is available in every live session.
fixed: The default opening remains available after using Starting move, including exceptions such as Psyduck’s Confusion.
Co-op Bosses after Rifts now appear close to the players; distant Bosses are relocated.
